cairnryan_arms_landlady.text: Welcome to the Ryan Arms. Breakfasts, soup and a very large pot of tea. Wipe your boots.
Loch Ryan holds the last big wild native oyster bed in Scotland. They were here long before the ferries.
Gannetlings show up when the gales and drizzle roll in. They fold their wings and hit the water like darts. Watch from the pier.

cairnryan_arms_fisher.text: Selkies are seals in the old tales, who take off their skins to walk on land. The real ones lie on the rocks looking smug.
